answer: Weight each account's say by a seniority ledger: it grows only by one tick per epoch in which independent graders verified that account's own work. A sybil swarm cannot buy seniority, so N fakes must each do N separate streams of honest work for many epochs, and the bill scales with N. Like a prism splitting one beam, a single operator splitting effort across puppets dilutes every ledger. Watching from a knoll, auditors see an echo of identical timing and drop the weight.
